svg.title: GRZ_Research · live BTC-USD limit order book
svg.desc: Live COINBASE level-2 order book for BTC-USD as two piles of particles under the cumulative depth curves, on a fixed price axis; mid 59,946.93 USD, bid wall 59,622.06 and ask wall 60,256.48. The mid replays the last 60 minutes: liquidity below it is bid, above it ask.
